schedule: Each client runs one query per second, choosing by a deterministic round-robin through the weighted operation cycle, offset by client number.
limitations: The mix and rate are explicit synthetic choices, not derived from tenant request telemetry.
Calls exercise the production compiled query service and Prisma read store directly, not HTTP routing, authentication, browser behavior, or network latency.
The Session 12 corpus has two fiscal years and a small synthetic record set; it is not a representative production-size database.
No source-change-to-verified-buyer-visible update latency, model cost, buyer workflow outcome, or production/AWS latency is measured.
